IsolateCentral.definition: Processing time for isolating at the central system for each intervention

ScanCentral.definition: Processing time for scanning at the central system for each intervention

IsolateDistributed.definition: Processing time for isolating at the distributed system for each intervention

ScanDistributed.definition: Processing time for scanning at the distributed system for each intervention

CentralMaxHours.definition: Maximum hours of operation for the central system

DistributedMaxHours.definition: Maximum hours of operation for the distributed system

objective.description: Minimize the total cost of interventions (central and distributed processing) required to halt the intruder’s progress, subject to processing time and maximum hour constraints.
objective.formulation: $\min \; CentralCost \sum_{i=1}^{N} \left( IsolateCentral_i \, isolateCentral_i + ScanCentral_i \, scanCentral_i \right) \;+\; DistributedCost \sum_{i=1}^{N} \left( IsolateDistributed_i \, isolateDistributed_i + ScanDistributed_i \, scanDistributed_i \right)$

constraints.description: Each cluster must be assigned exactly one intervention type and one processing method (i.e., exactly one (type, method) combination per cluster)
constraints.formulation: $\\forall i = 1, \\dots, N:\\; isolateCentral[i] + isolateDistributed[i] + scanCentral[i] + scanDistributed[i] = 1$

constraints.description: The total central processing time (sum of processing times for all clusters assigned to central processing with their chosen intervention type) must not exceed CentralMaxHours
The total distributed processing time (sum of processing times for all clusters assigned to distributed processing with their chosen intervention type) must not exceed DistributedMaxHours
All decision variables indicating intervention type and processing method assignments must be binary (0 or 1)
constraints.formulation: $\\forall i = 1, \\dots, N:\\; isolateCentral[i],\\; isolateDistributed[i],\\; scanCentral[i],\\; scanDistributed[i] \\in \\{0,1\\}$

isolateCentral.definition: Equals 1 if cluster i is assigned isolation with central processing, 0 otherwise

isolateDistributed.definition: Equals 1 if cluster i is assigned isolation with distributed processing, 0 otherwise

scanCentral.definition: Equals 1 if cluster i is assigned scanning with central processing, 0 otherwise

scanDistributed.definition: Equals 1 if cluster i is assigned scanning with distributed processing, 0 otherwise
